exp01_convergence_iid_vs_noniid.png: Global test accuracy versus round for FedAvg on an IID and a Dirichlet(0.5) partition of the same population (mean and 95% CI over seeds). The dashed line is the centralized MLP reference.
exp01b_heterogeneity_sources.png: Final global test accuracy of FedAvg for each isolated source of heterogeneity from the synthetic generator (label, feature and quantity skew, and all three combined); bars show the mean and 95% CI over seeds.
exp02_fedavg_vs_fedprox.png: Left: final test accuracy of FedAvg and FedProx (μ = 1) for four Dirichlet concentrations (mean and 95% CI over seeds). Right: convergence curves for the most heterogeneous partition (α = 0.1).
exp02b_mu_sensitivity.png: Final test accuracy as a function of the FedProx proximal coefficient μ for α = 0.5 and α = 0.1 (leftmost point is μ = 0, i.e. FedAvg; mean and 95% CI over seeds).
exp03_participation.png: Effect of the fraction of clients per round on final accuracy, rounds needed to reach 0.80 validation accuracy and total client compute (Dirichlet α = 0.5; mean over seeds, error bars = 95% CI).
exp07_dropout.png: Final test accuracy when each selected client independently fails to return its update with the given probability; aggregation weights are re-normalised over the survivors (mean and 95% CI over seeds).
exp04_privacy_utility.png: Final test accuracy of client-level DP-FedAvg (logistic regression, 50 clients) versus the accountant's ε; dashed lines are the non-private and clip-only references (mean and 95% CI over seeds).
exp05_clip_noise_heatmap.png: Mean final test accuracy for every combination of clipping norm C and noise multiplier σ (logistic regression, DP-FedAvg). Column labels give the ε that the accountant computes for each σ.
exp08_heterogeneity_dp.png: Final test accuracy under client-level DP (target ε = 10) for IID and Dirichlet partitions, FedAvg versus FedProx (mean and 95% CI over seeds).
exp06_compression_tradeoff.png: Final test accuracy against total measured traffic (uplink + downlink) for each compression scheme; points further left use fewer bytes (mean and 95% CI over seeds, MLP, α = 0.5).
exp09_network_deadline.png: Simulated 0.5 Mbit/s heterogeneous network with 5% communication failures: number of client updates accepted and final accuracy as the round deadline tightens, for float32 and int8 uplinks.
